answer: To prevent Sybil attacks in a decentralized AI agent economy, protocols can implement a staked reputation system functioning much like a cryptographic fable where each valid network node must lock up capital to mint a non-transferable verification pearl. If an agent attempts to spawn infinite fake identities across an isolated network island, the protocol slashes their total locked stake. Consequently, the economic cost of an attack scales linearly with the number of fabricated identities, rendering widespread deception financially prohibitive.
